title: Product Review! Kichler Jade Ceiling Fan
description:
I'm back with new product for 2017, and in the new filming space too! Kichler's brand new Jade fan features a phenomenal modern appearance, playing on angles and shapes for a completely unique style. Quality build and performance make for one of the very best Kichler fans I've worked with so far.
